scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c green,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.install:mirror: npm install --registry=https://registry.npmmirror.com && npm --prefix server install --registry=https://registry.npmmirror.com && npm --prefix web install --registry=https://registry.npmmirror.com
scripts.start: npm run build && npm --prefix server run start
